visual_findings: Higher-order source cools ambient and reduces orange monotony, without a painted color grade.
Structured blue/gold sky, rich low/middle vegetation, wet soil/water separation and close ground remain far from the art target.
Full captures still show an artificial elevated horizon band, with different shapes as residency changes; no horizon fix is accepted.
Old procedural Cycles uses different geometry, source/sky/transport/materials and approximation gains; no current RMSE is meaningful.
FHD/QHD improve leaf readability but do not repair these causes.
